title: Faded Drow Leather Armour
summary: Light Armour with base AC 12 plus Dexterity. Successfully identifying it grants The Spider’s Gift inspiration to Guild Artisans.

fields.Inspiration: At pickup, identify the armour with a party member who has at least +5 History or is a Drow, Duergar, or Deep Gnome. Hirelings of those ancestries qualify. Successful identification grants The Spider’s Gift inspiration to Guild Artisans.
fields.Base value: 130 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
